page.content:
Woods Hole's three-person deep submersible, workhorse of vent dives.

How DSV Alvin connects

  • Faction: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution — Alvin is operated by Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution.
  • Location: Hydrothermal vents — Alvin dived the Galápagos Rift when vents were first seen.
  • Character: Robert Ballard — Ballard explored ridges and wrecks with Alvin and towed systems.

What is DSV Alvin?

Alvin, operated by Woods Hole, reached the Galápagos vents, the Titanic, and countless ridge and trench sites as the United States' longest-serving deep research sub.

Key threads lead to Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution, Hydrothermal vents and Robert Ballard.
